info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Collateral Attributes API
info.description: The Manage Collateral Attributes API enables financial institutions to modify existing collateral details associated with loan applications. By utilizing this endpoint, authorized users can update attributes such as value, type, and associated documentation for specific collaterals linked to loan applications. Typical consumers include loan officers and financial analysts who require up-to-date collateral information to assess loan risk and ensure compliance. This API helps streamline operations and maintain accurate loan records for improved decision-making.

patch.summary: Update collateral details for a loan application.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the collateral details associated with a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes of the collateral to reflect the latest information or requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to update the collateral details for the loan application identified by RES-100045. It is structured in JSON format to ensure seamless data interchange, and it contains the fields required to specify modifications to the collateral information.
